propositions: Every CI job makes an avoidable network call to raw.githubusercontent.com to fetch a remote uv version manifest because uv itself is unpinned at all 25 setup-uv call sites across 12 workflow files.

The setup-uv action's WorkspaceVersionResolver scans pyproject.toml for [tool.uv] required-version, and when absent falls back to LatestVersionResolver which fetches the manifest; an exact pin (==X.Y.Z) resolves locally with no network, but a range specifier (>=, ~=) or bare version still triggers a fetch.
Pinning uv to an exact version in [tool.uv] required-version = "==0.12.7" in the root pyproject.toml removes the resolution fetch and reaches all 25 call sites without modifying any workflow file.
setup-uv still makes a second unconditional manifest fetch in getArtifact to look up the download URL, so one fetch per job remains even after the version is pinned locally.
A new guard script (check_uv_pin.py) validates that the pin exists, is exact (not a range), and no workflow step overrides it with version: or version-file: inputs, preventing silent divergence.
